  • Deprecated Classes
    Class
    Description
    teilchen.force.LineDeflector2D
    use LineCollider2D and add it with Physics.add(Constraint). this class wraps a LineCollider2D for compatibility.
    teilchen.force.PlaneDeflector
    use PlaneCollider and add it with Physics.add(Constraint). this class wraps a PlaneCollider for compatibility.
    teilchen.force.SphereDeflector
    use SphereCollider and add it with Physics.add(Constraint). this class wraps a SphereCollider for compatibility.
    teilchen.force.TriangleDeflector
    use TriangleCollider or TriangleMeshCollider and add it with Physics.add(Constraint). this class wraps a TriangleCollider for compatibility.
    teilchen.force.TriangleDeflectorIndexed
    use TriangleMeshCollider with an indexed vertex array.
    teilchen.integration.Util
    use IntegrationUtil instead.
